name: Owl Files Saver
description: A private, offline file saver for Android. Save shared files in one tap, organise them and keep them on your device.
details: Owl Files Saver is a private, offline file saver, storage organiser and status vault for Android. Save, organise and safeguard shared files, photos, videos and statuses directly on your device, with no internet access required.
features: One-tap save from the Android share sheet to the storage folder you choose.
Status saver for WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business, with a fullscreen viewer.
Built-in video player with touch controls and a mute toggle.
Day and dark themes, including an OLED-friendly dark mode.
App lock with a private offline 4-digit PIN.
History with filters (images, documents, media, archives) and search by filename or extension.
No internet permission, no analytics and no ads. Your files never leave your device.

name: MedQuiz
description: Offline medical MCQ practice for exam preparation. 10,012 MCQs with explanations, progress statistics and a daily study reminder, all on your device.
details: MedQuiz is an offline medical MCQ study and exam preparation app for medical students, healthcare trainees and adult learners. It works completely offline, with no registration, no login and no personal information sent to any server.
features: 10,012 MCQs with explanations that work 100% offline.
Quiz history, scores and accuracy statistics by subject and topic.
Bookmarked questions and a study streak.
Optional daily study reminder at 8:00 PM.
No ads, no in-app purchases and no account needed.
detailsSource: MedQuiz privacy policy supplied by Arslan Tahir (2026-11-25)

p: MedQuiz (“we”, “our”, or “the App”) is an offline medical MCQ study and exam preparation application. Your privacy is important to us. MedQuiz is designed to work completely offline without requiring user registration, login, or submission of personal information to external servers.

sections.h: 2. Information Stored Locally on Your Device
p: MedQuiz does not collect, transmit, or store personal data on remote servers. All study data stays strictly on your device in local storage (Room SQLite database and Android SharedPreferences), including:
ul: Quiz attempts, scores, subject/topic accuracy statistics, and quiz history
Bookmarked questions and study streak dates
Optional display name entered inside the app (defaults to “Doctor”)
App preferences such as Dark/Light theme and Daily Reminder toggle status
after: You can delete all of this local data at any time by tapping “Reset progress” in the Progress tab or by uninstalling the App.

p: MedQuiz requests only the minimum permissions necessary for its core features:
ul: Notifications (POST_NOTIFICATIONS): Optional permission requested only when you choose to enable the Daily Study Reminder (8:00 PM local notification). You can turn reminders off anytime from the Home screen bell icon or Progress > Preferences, or in your device Settings.
Run at Startup (RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED): Used strictly to restore your active local daily study reminder alarm if your device restarts.

Network Access (INTERNET / ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE): All 10,012 MCQs and explanations work 100% offline. Network access is only used if you tap external links in the app to open https://lexdataai.com/ in your device browser.
MedQuiz displays no advertisements and includes no in-app purchases.
We do not sell, rent, or share any user data with third parties.
Tapping the “Updates, lectures & courses” option opens https://lexdataai.com/ in your external browser, where any interaction on that website is governed by the website’s own privacy practices.

p: MedQuiz is intended for medical students, healthcare trainees, and adult learners. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 years of age.
MedQuiz is provided strictly for educational and medical exam preparation purposes. It is not a medical device and must not be used for clinical diagnosis, treatment, or patient care decisions.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any updates will be reflected by updating the Effective Date at the top of this page.
